Format estimate

Source: R/AutoScript.format.R
AS.format.estimate.Rd

Computes a string with an estimate, 95% confidence interval, and p-value. The confidence interval is either supplied directly or computed from the standard error.

Usage

AS.format.estimate(
  est,
  SE = NULL,
  p,
  exp = FALSE,
  name = "HR",
  LL = NULL,
  UL = NULL
)

Arguments

est

Estimate, on the log scale if exp = TRUE.

SE

Optional standard error, on the same scale as est.

p

P-value.

exp

Logical; if TRUE, est, LL, and UL are exponentiated. Default = FALSE.

name

A string displayed before the estimate. Default = "HR".

LL

Optional lower 95% confidence limit, on the same scale as est.

UL

Optional upper 95% confidence limit, on the same scale as est.

Value

A string of the form "name est (95%CI LL–UL), p = p".
